answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened in the valley: child-burning, its defiling, and the LORD's word that it would be renamed.

clauses.english: was where the people burned their sons and daughters in the fire
clauses.quote: to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire

clauses.english: had its Topheth defiled so that none might pass a child through fire to Molech
clauses.quote: he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom

clauses.english: was declared by the LORD to be renamed the valley of slaughter

doubts: JOS 15:8, JOS 18:16 and NEH 11:30 only mark a boundary or limit of settlement and were left out.
JER 2:23 says 'the valley' without naming Hinnom; it may not refer to this valley, so it was left out.
